## Où j'en suis
SAML SSO for Fernhill is implemented and tested on staging with real login working end-to-end after fixing a RelayState length issue. JIT provisioning is merged, and group-to-role mapping is in an open PR. We are waiting for Fernhill IT to add the groups claim to their IdP before the Thursday demo. (source: ses-sso-3, s3-11, src-linear-kes311)

- [en-cours] PR #421 for SAML group to role mapping and short RelayState is open. (source: ses-sso-3, s3-06, kestrel-analytics/platform#421)
- [prochaine-étape] Wait for Fernhill IT to add the groups claim to their staging IdP. (source: ses-sso-3, s3-08, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] Create the admin test account once the groups claim is available for the Thursday demo. (source: ses-sso-3, s3-08)
- [essai-raté] Sending the full return URL as RelayState failed because Fernhill ADFS enforces an 80-byte limit; fixed by storing the URL in Redis and sending a short opaque ID. (source: ses-sso-3, s3-02, s3-04)
- [décision] Default role for new JIT users is viewer, not analyst or editor. (source: s1-05, s3-07)
- [décision] SP-initiated login stays enabled despite Fernhill IT requesting IdP-initiated only. (source: s3-07)
- [décision] Only verified domains are accepted for JIT provisioning. (source: s2-03)
